biggest_catch: MidAmerican must provide the primary electricity to the equipment, the rebate can never exceed 70% of the equipment cost, and you must apply within 90 days of purchase or by December 31, 2026 — whichever comes first.
catches: MidAmerican Energy must provide the primary electricity (or natural gas) to the equipment being rebated.
Rebate payments cannot exceed 70% of the equipment cost (labor excluded).
Apply within 90 days of purchase or by December 31, 2026, whichever comes first; equipment must be purchased, installed, and operating between Jan 1 and Dec 31, 2026.
Limit of two rebates per piece of equipment per installation address.
Smart thermostat must be ENERGY STAR, replace an existing manual/programmable thermostat, and be installed, Wi-Fi-connected, and registered before applying.
The qualifying appliance purchase is a condition, not an upfront fee.

steps: Buy qualifying ENERGY STAR equipment (washer, electric dryer, refrigerator, freezer, heat-pump water heater, or smart thermostat).
Install it and get it operating at your MidAmerican-served address between January 1 and December 31, 2026.
For a smart thermostat: install, connect to Wi-Fi, and register it with the manufacturer before applying.
Submit the rebate application online within 90 days of purchase (or by December 31, 2026, whichever comes first) with your itemized sales receipt.
Receive your rebate (capped at 70% of equipment cost); MidAmerican does not publish the payout timeline.
timing: MidAmerican does not publish a payout timeline for these rebates on the official page.
